```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(l1ou) # this needs to be downloaded from github
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(geiger)
library(dplyr)
library(phytools)
library(plyr)
library(Momocs)
library(ggpubr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)

# Load necessary libraries
library(Hmisc)
library(corrplot)

# Load necessary libraries
library(dunn.test)  # For post-hoc analysis

```


```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}



# Load your files
pca <- read_csv("Results/Ecology/Ecology_maximum_inferred.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

agg <- read_csv("Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

vol <- read_csv("Results/Volume/Volume.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

# Merge all
df <- pca %>%
  left_join(agg, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(vol %>% select(species, avg_volume_estimated), by = "species")

p <- ggboxplot(df, x = "Ecology", y = "PC1_mean", color = "Ecology",
          add = "jitter", title = "PC1 Mean by Ecology") +
stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label.y = max(df$PC1_mean, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05)

ggsave("PC1 Mean by Ecology.jpg", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


# ANOVA Test
anova_result <- aov(PC1_mean ~ Ecology, data = df)
summary(anova_result)

# Kruskal-Wallis Test (if data not normal)
kruskal.test(PC1_mean ~ Ecology, data = df)

# Post-hoc (if Kruskal-Wallis is significant)
dunn.test::dunn.test(df$PC1_mean, df$Ecology, method = "bonferroni")


```


```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


# Do same for volume
p <-  ggboxplot(df, x = "Ecology", y = "avg_volume_estimated", color = "Ecology",
          add = "jitter", title = "Volume by Ecology") +
stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label.y = max(df$avg_volume_estimated, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05)

ggsave("Volume Mean by Ecology.jpg", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# ANOVA Test
anova_result <- aov(avg_volume_estimated ~ Ecology, data = df)
summary(anova_result)

# Kruskal-Wallis Test (if data not normal)
kruskal.test(avg_volume_estimated ~ Ecology, data = df)

# Post-hoc (if Kruskal-Wallis is significant)
dunn.test::dunn.test(df$avg_volume_estimated, df$Ecology, method = "bonferroni")


```


```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Scatterplot with separate group-wise correlations
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1_mean, y = avg_volume_estimated, color = Ecology)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", aes(group = Ecology)) +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson",
           aes(group = Ecology),
           label.y.npc = c(0.9, 0.8),  # adjust as needed for more groups
           size = 5,
           group.by = "Ecology") +
  labs(
    x = "PC1 (Spore Shape Axis)",
    y = "Estimated Spore Volume",
    title = "Spore Shape vs Volume by Ecology"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("PC1_vs_Volume_by_Ecology.jpg", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


# Save it
ggsave("PC1_vs_Volume_by_Ecology.jpg", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```
